description: Peggy Hewes Newbury, VT Well, I am breaking my own rule here. As an employee of the Town of Newbury, albeit in a very minor capacity, I’ve avoided making public my political positions. But I feel impelled to do so now in support of Susan Culp’s candidacy for VT State Representative.

title: In support of Culp
